environment: TRAE build environment: no Host Web Search capability available

status_meaning.verified: host search returned a relevant original page with a real date
status_meaning.failed: probe ran and could not obtain a relevant page or date

how_to_run: Run one bounded query per platform with the domain restriction; capture the final URL, the page's own publication date, and a short supporting snippet; flip status to verified/failed with verified_at. Do not mark verified from a search-result snippet alone when the page date is unavailable.
